## Question or correction

Describe the claim or result and link its scene, candidate ID, or evidence file.

## Supporting evidence

Include primary source links, observation times, units, and relevant limitations.
Do not include credentials or signed download URLs.

## Proposed check

What experiment could reject or support the interpretation? What would each
possible outcome change?
